 Summary
 Kluivert and Tavernier penalties, plus Adli free-kick give Bournemouth win against AC Milan as Maignan sent off
 FT: Palace pegged back by Besiktas before Turkish side reduced to 10
 Celtic beaten by Celta Vigo 
 Tutierov heads early Sunderland opener but Lech Poznan earn draw in Europa League
 Jablonec hold Brighton plus Trabzonspor beat Hearts in Conference League
 From Bury to dreamland: Bournemouth's rise

 Gary Rose and Callum Matthews
 Show Most recent Most popular 'The thing I love about our team is the intensity we have' published at 22:29 BST 22:29 BST 
 FT: Bournemouth 3-0 AC Milan 
 Bournemouth 
 Bournemouth winger Justin Kluivert speaking to TNT Sport: "It means a lot. we come from two victories which gave us a good feeling going into this game. We just trusted in ourselves, it doesn't matter who we play against we just trust in ourselves. We know what we are capable of and I think we showed that tonight."
 On playing AC Milan: "AC Milan have a lot of history, it's a big club, and it's beautiful because what I didn't know before is that we have comparisons, the colours we have red and black, comes from AC Milan."
 On things finally clicking: "We know this run we have now, three wins, no goals conceded is something that I'm proud of, and we need to continue. We know how to continue we have done it before. We have a full squad now nearly fit, we have other guys coming back, so that competition makes it better. The thing I love about our team is the intensity we have, it doesn't matter who's in the starting 11, our intensity shows who we are and what we stand for, let's go full gas."
 On scoring the first penalty but not taking the second: "I think scored three one time in a game, but you got to be generous. I got to give my team-mates also the good feeling, and they also deserve to score penalty, because I also know they can score. We are a team, and not individuals."

 'Special night for the club but it becomes a lot more special if you go and win' published at 22:22 BST 22:22 BST 
 FT: Bournemouth 3-0 AC Milan 
 Bournemouth 
 Bournemouth midfielder Ryan Christie speaking to TNT Sports: "What a night. The boys spoke about it before the game, listen it's a special night for the club but it becomes a lot more special if you go and win the game. Amazing, it's been such an experience playing in Europe, the fans have been amazing, the whole infrastructure the club have brought, in terms of the whole atmosphere coming into tonight and last week as well. It's incredible. It's a run of good results now, we need to keep going."
 On what it means to the fans: "It's mega. In terms of the story of the club it's ridiculous. Someone told me today, 15 years ago today we were 17th in League One I think so it's pretty incredible. So many of these fans have been here for this journey so to have nights like this and win as well is special."
 On momentum: "Now that we've got that bit of momentum. I think it's crucial when you've got so many games one after the other you just try and roll into the next one and keep the positivity. With the amount of games we've got, the gaffer has to use everyone in the squad and to be fair everyone has shown they can be called upon, the boys that came in tonight. Incredible tonight to come in and perform like that against a top team. Positivity going into the weekend.

 Sage will be 'delighted in many, many ways' published at 22:18 BST 22:18 BST 
 FT: Besiktas 2-2 Crystal Palace 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 I think he will be absolutely delighted with the performance. It's been excellent. They got thrashed by Brighton and have come out and played excellent in both sides of the game. The subs have had an impact, and I think they deserve to win this game.
 I think he will be disappointed with [the result], but he will also be delighted in many, many ways.

 'What a brilliant, brilliant night' published at 22:11 BST 22:11 BST 
 FT: Bournemouth 3-0 AC Milan 
 Robbie Savage 
Peterborough manager and former Wales midfielder on TNT Sports 
 An amazing night. From the first minute they showed the intent, on the front foot closing down. Had that big chance from Kluivert, then Evanilson with the header leading to the penalty. 
 Two penalties, deservedly so and the sending off. Good second half, three goals. What a brilliant, brilliant night.

 get involved Get Involved published at 22:10 BST 22:10 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 I really hope this is reported as an epic victory for Bournemouth, rather than a humiliating defeat for Milan. Too often, wins for so called 'lesser' teams don't get the credit they deserve, in public debate or the media, but Bournemouth have totally destroyed one of European football's giants tonight!
 JD 
 352 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Very impressive performance' published at 22:06 BST 22:06 BST 
 FT: Besiktas 2-2 Crystal Palace 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 I thought they deserved to win the game. The stats at half-time weren't really truthful in many ways, They created four chances, and could have easily have gone in 2-0 up.
 What I was impressed with was that in the second half they came out and maintained that even though Besiktas came back at them. [Crystal Palace] kept foraging forward, kept the ball, kept closing the ball down. Very impressive performance, it's something they can hold onto, and move forward with.
 122 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22:03 BST 22:03 BST 
 FT: Bournemouth 3-0 AC Milan 
 It was another poor night for Ruben Amorim and AC Milan.
 They've suffered defeat in two of their three Europa League games now, failing to score in both. They didn't even have a shot on target today. 
 They lost captain Mike Maignan to a red card too and he won't be available for their next match against Ferencvaros, who are three from three so far. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 134 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Milan players and staff clashed with celebrating Bournemouth stars published at 22:01 BST 22:01 BST 
 FT: Bournemouth 3-0 AC Milan 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport senior football reporter at the Vitality Stadium 
 There were many at Milan who were not happy with just how much many of the Bournemouth players were celebrating victory. 
 A reaction came from some staff members of the Italian club towards several players, with Adam Smith among those caught in the fracas.
 It looks like many of those at Milan have not taken this defeat well, with Cherries manager Marco Rose having also argued with members of Ruben Amorim's staff.

 Post published at 21:59 BST 21:59 BST 
 FT: Bournemouth 3-0 AC Milan 
 Bournemouth sit third in the Europa League table and are one of just five teams with a perfect three from three record. 
 They sit behind Benfica and Bayer Leverkusen.
 Marco Rose's side visit Sparta Prague and Celta Vigo in November.
